steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Hibiscus!

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Where are you!

steps.name: Injured Boy
steps.text: My leg... it hurts...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's ok. Stay still, and let me have a look.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's just a bruise. No bleeding or fractures. I'll rub some salve on it and you'll be fine.

steps.name: Injured Boy
steps.text: But it hurts so much when I try to move...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I know how it feels. I hurt my leg once when I was little. It really hurt, and I was bleeding and scared. I couldn't stop crying.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But you're not crying. That means you're a strong boy, aren't you?

steps.name: Injured Boy
steps.text: (Rubs eyes)

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But it's not gonna get better by itself if you sit here like this.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Would you rather sit in the cold and the rain, or go home and get better on your warm and comfy bed?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Come, take my hand, and stand up. Good. Can you go home by yourself?

steps.name: Injured Boy
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Good boy. Now go on home; your mum and dad are waiting.

steps.name: Injured Boy
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Hibiscus!

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: What happened at the concert, Hibiscus? Why are you here by yourself?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Andante... perfect timing.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: No time to explain. I just patched up a few injuries here.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But Originium levels are very high around here. Take them to the office for a closer look...

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: What the heck are you talking about?!

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: What's with all those wounds on you? You're in no shape to help anybody!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Wounds? What are you—

steps.name: Old Man
steps.text: Young lady, why do you—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll hold down the fort here, Ebenholz. Now!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It can't be. I thought I blocked it...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Don't worry, I learned a few things from Lava. I know some Ar—

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Hibiscus!
A few days ago...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Hello, this is the medical assistance center. Is this the number of Mr. Darron?

steps.name: Sickly Man
steps.text: It's you... where's Andante?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Dr. Andante is out visiting patients, so I'm checking on you on her behalf. Don't worry, I received the same professional training.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: May I come in to do a few checks? Just some basic tests. No blood will be drawn—

steps.name: Sickly Man
steps.text: Stay away from my house!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I won't come near without your permission.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But you do not sound well. You should get yourself checked up—

steps.name: Sickly Man
steps.text: It's none of your business!

steps.name: Sickly Man
steps.text: I was feeling perfectly fine until you came to the Afterglow, Sarkaz!

steps.name: Sickly Man
steps.text: The prophecies were right! You Sarkaz have brought calamity upon the Afterglow!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's a complicated situation, and hard to explain... but you need help, and your health should come first.

steps.name: Sickly Man
steps.text: Enough! I'm not gonna grovel to a Sarkaz, even on my deathbed.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Very well, I won't force you, if you don't want to get checked up.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Here's some medicine that may help... please don't consider it help from a Sarkaz. I'm simply delivering medicine to those in need, on behalf of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll leave the medicine at the door. You can pick it up at your convenience.

steps.name: Sickly Man
steps.text: Go away... or I'll call the guards.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sorry... I'll be going.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I've gone through the Afterglow. Based on the number of Infected who have recovered abnormally, we don't have enough supplies at the office to deal with a crisis.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Why hasn't the medicine we ordered come in? I hope that patient doesn't waste the doses...
Hibiscus—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...What?
As though hearing a call from afar, Hibiscus turns around, but finds no one there.
Every door and window is closed, as though the scenes of song and dance from a few days ago were merely an illusion.
But the weathered walls and battered tiles look so familiar upon close inspection.

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: I asked you to carry ingredients for tomorrow into the warehouse, but I didn't expect you to carry enough to last a week. Aren't you tired?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Ha, don't underestimate Sarkaz strength!

steps.name: Food Stall Owner
steps.text: Alright... still, you must be tired. Here, have two servings of fins & chips, and share it with your sister.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Thanks, but I think mom has dinner ready. I'll just take one serving and share it with Lava.

steps.name: Fruit Stall Owner
steps.text: See? You shouldn't give a young lady too much fried food.

steps.name: Fruit Stall Owner
steps.text: Here, take this bag of fruit. Guaranteed to be sweet and juicy.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Thanks!

steps.name: Fruit Stall Owner
steps.text: You're welcome. I'm counting on you to tutor that little brat of mine!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Come on, Hibiscus, focus...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm back.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Why have you gone out again? Didn't I say I would take care of the investigation for a few days?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Things in the Afterglow are complicated. I can't just leave it all to you.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: All I did was deliver some medicine to patients in need. I won't draw any attention.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Did anyone bother you...?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit says a medic's first duty on a field mission is to her own safety.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: What happened the other day—it was their fault, but you shouldn't have charged ahead like that. It was dangerous.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sorry. I realized afterwards that I should have taken another path... I was angry and anxious, and being right was all I could think of.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But thinking back now, there was really no point to an argument like that.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Good that you realize your mistake. Next time you put yourself in danger like that, I'm putting it in my report.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm sure they meant nothing by it. They're just scared after all that's happened lately.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I remember being invited to dance my first day in the Afterglow.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: They probably just mistook you for a Caprinae...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I don't think so.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I used to think there wasn't much difference between the horn of a Caprinae and that of a Sarkaz, but I recently learned that the Caprinae are able to tell them apart at a glance.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Let me tell you something funny.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I found a Caprinae girl unconscious by the roadside before I arrived in Vyseheim.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I gave her some medicine and water. When she woke up, she recognized me as a Sarkaz and looked scared.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I panicked and said, 'Don't worry, I'm a Caprinae too!'

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: She didn't believe me and ran away screaming.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It was so funny, now that I think of it. Why would a Sarkaz introduce herself like that?

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: It's not funny at all.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll get the door.

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: It's you...?

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: You just left my house! Don't you remember?

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: I'm his son! You sucked my father's blood!

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: I'm looking for Dr. Andante. Where is she?

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: (Gestures 'pretend I'm not here')

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: She's not here right now. I can help, if you need something.

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: Er, I...

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: P-Please help my father!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: He was feeling well a few days ago, but things took a bad turn this morning.

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: He's running a high fever, and new crystals are appearing on his skin...

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: Please, help him!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Take me to him.

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: Y-You'll do it? Than—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: No time to talk, let's go.

steps.name: Sickly Old Man
steps.text: (Anguished moaning)

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: Doktor, will my father—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I performed some basic treatment to stabilize his condition. He's out of danger for now. Let him sleep.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: Will he get better?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I can't give you any false hope.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: But why...?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: As is the case with many others in the Afterglow, your father's condition is a type of 'false recovery.'

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The body draws on undamaged organs to fill in for functions that have been damaged, but this is only a stop-gap measure.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Your father is now undergoing the rebound that follows a false recovery. His age only compounds the rapid onset of Oripathy symptoms.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: I remember you saying something to the effect.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: It's all my fault. If only I had...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: There's no point regretting the past. The important thing is to take care of your father now.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Pay careful attention to his diet, his sleep cycle, and keep his bodily functions in balance. Care is more important than treatment right now.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: Alright, I'll do it.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: And Dr. Hibiscus... I, I'm sorry about—

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Are you there, Hibiscus?

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Something's not right. We need to—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Don't disturb the patient. We'll talk outside.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: A dozen patients came into the office right after you left. Some had suddenly lost consciousness, while others experienced a rapid deterioration in vitals.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Other patients are also coming in with various symptoms, but we haven't been able to determine if they are Oripathy-related.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Schneider's father was not an isolated case. Many patients who had recovered abnormally are entering the rebound stage.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Rhodes Island alone can't take in everyone. Have you asked if the other hospitals can accept patients, or deliver the medicine that we ordered?

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: I have, but they keep finding excuses. And they said...

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: They needed to ensure sufficient medical supplies for the Cliffy Patio.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: How could they be so irresponsible!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Hang in there, Andante. I'm coming back—

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Calm down, Hibiscus.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: People are restless right now, and there are many who believe the rumors. This is not the time to show your face.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But I can't—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...You're right.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Could you take care of things at the office, Andante?

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Of course. I haven't spent all this time in the Afterglow for nothing.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: I'll help!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But your father...

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: The neighbors can care for him for a while. You're short-handed, aren't you?

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: I can help. Anything you need.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Alright, this is the list of patients who recovered abnormally.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You know the Afterglow. Check the list and bring the patients who have deteriorated quickly to the office for intensive care.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll take care of the hospitals.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll convince them.

steps.name: Panicking Infected
steps.text: Doktor! Help me!

steps.name: Crying Child
steps.text: I wanna go home...
The room is packed with several times the normal number of patients.
There is a sickly smell in the air, which is filled with the sounds of crying and moaning.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: Ugh, what's this smell... I have the patients, Dr. Andante.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: There are too many of them. It's far more than the number of abnormal recoveries we recorded.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: We have our hands full with the cross-infection risk alone.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You're right. Panic may be even more dangerous than the disease.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The patients don't know their own situations. Whether they're experiencing the rebound or not, Oripathy sufferers believe that their condition is being caused by some unknown threat.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The first priority is to identify the cause of the symptoms, and deal with it individually.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Patients in the rebound stage experience a rapid decline in bodily functions. In the absence of blood tests, body temperature is the most direct sympt—

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Hibiscus! Are you alright over there?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I... I'm fine.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Take care of the office, Andante.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll get the medicine.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Alright, be careful!

steps.name: Patrol Officer
steps.text: Is this the troublemaker?

steps.name: Private Hospital Doctor
steps.text: This is private property, Fräulein. Even members of other medical institutions require permission to enter.

steps.name: Private Hospital Doctor
steps.text: This is your last warning. Leave now.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I didn't come to interrupt the work of a fellow medical professional.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But how could you talk about not having enough supplies or beds, when a single flu patient could take up enough space for ten people?

steps.name: Private Hospital Doctor
steps.text: We make our decisions based on each patient's unique circumstances...

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: S-She's the prophesied devil, isn't she?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Help! Somebody! Get this Sarkaz out of my room!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If I really were the prophesied devil, do you think there's anyone here who could help you?

steps.name: Leithanian Noble
steps.text: Eeek—

steps.name: Patrol Officer
steps.text: No sudden moves!
A dozen wands are aimed at Hibiscus.

steps.name: Private Hospital Doctor
steps.text: Please don't threaten our patients.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm not threatening anyone. I'm just reminding you, as a fellow doctor, of your moral obligations.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The people of the Afterglow are in serious trouble. I only ask that you provide the necessary medicine to the Rhodes Island branch office and take in a number of patients, in accordance with our agreement.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Am I asking too much?

steps.name: Private Hospital Doctor
steps.text: Why would I listen to a suspicious foreigner? Everyone knows about the prophecy.

steps.name: Private Hospital Doctor
steps.text: I'm not wasting my time with her. Remove her from the premises, officer.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Fine, call me a devil, then.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Do you remember what the prophecy that you put so much stock in says?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: 'The Blood hides Plague within, slow beckons Death to creep all Ways.' Where do you think things stand with the Afterglow right now?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The prophesied devil stands before you. Take me in, or chase me out. Do whatever you think will protect you.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: And we'll see how high and mighty the Cliffy Patio fares, when calamity strikes.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Karl—temperatures normal, small increase in blood Originium levels.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mrs. Marta—temperatures normal, blood Originium levels normal.

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Too many files... too much equipment... I, I can't carry any more...

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: No more health food... I need meat...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Looks like she didn't have the time to eat today. She's dreaming about food.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Hey, Andante, you're drooling.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: Dr. Hibiscus... you're still up?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Just filing some patient data. It's not easy for me to go out during the day, so I have to make it up at night.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Thanks for helping out today. You should go home.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: I... I'll stay here. Here's some water for you.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Thank you.
Hibiscus reaches out to take the bottle, but it slips from her hand and rolls across the floor.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sorry... I'll get it.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm fine. Just careless.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: Ambulances came this afternoon, not long after you left. How did you persuade them?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Not exactly with logic and reason, I guess.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Anyway, it's good that things have calmed down. The temporary quarantine zone should be lifted tomorrow.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: Dr. Hibiscus... I have a question.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: You're new here in the Afterglow. It's not like you had time to make friends, and some folk have even treated you terribly. Why are you still willing to...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I think this is the first time I've been treated like a doctor.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I mostly do the work of a nurse back at HQ, caring for patients and assisting doctors. This is the first time I've been put in charge of things.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You call me doctor, so I had better do my job.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: You... you'll forgive what I said to you?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What if I say no?

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: I'm sorry! I'm really sorry!

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: You can hit me with that flute if you want!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm just joking. No need to slap yourself.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm not going to pretend that it didn't bother me at all, but it's understandable.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: In the face of terrible danger and an unknown threat, it's natural for people to become wary of outsiders.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: Do you really think so?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: And if I just packed up and left, I would really become the prophesied devil who brought disaster to the Afterglow and then disappeared, wouldn't I?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Hate leads only to hate, never to understanding.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I just hope I can fix people's prejudices with my actions, even just a little bit...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sorry, I wandered off there.

steps.name: Schneider
steps.text: You should get some rest. I'll be over there, and you can call me if you need anything.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Whew... things are finally settling down.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I should have a sip of water and take a break—

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: Cough... cough...

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: Water... I'm thirsty... water...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh, here's some water for you!

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: Cough... cough... whew...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Feeling better?

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: A-Are you a Sarkaz?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Er... maybe you could treat me as a Caprinae?

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: Pah, I can tell the horns of a Sarkaz from those of a Caprinae at a sight.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Ah, so it's true.

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: Seeing a Sarkaz under a full moon... am I going to die?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I've never heard that legend before.

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: Ouch, my head hurts. Guess I'm starting to ramble.

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: Thank you for the care... let's sing a song, whether you're Sarkaz or Caprinae.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: A song? You should rest up. Your condition has just stabilized.

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: It's too quiet... we need some music tonight, even if I die tomorrow.

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: I'll sing. Accompany me with your flute.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Very well, if it makes you feel better...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But I'm not great at the flute.

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: It's easy. Just follow my melody.

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: I'll start. One, two—

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: The Sky is blue and fine, the Breeze lilts by in Song♪

steps.name: Feeble Patient
steps.text: The River murmurs clear, my Heart is filled with Hope♪...
The alley is quiet, cleared to accommodate the overflow of patients.
The intermittent sounds of flute and singing echo under the moon, a lullaby for a city just emerging from chaos.
